corrections.before: está presente; está en un lugar o estado
corrections.after: está en un lugar o estado (cosas y plantas)
corrections.evidence: COERLL lesson 25, section 1, body 1 explicitly restricts eltoc to non-animate subjects and plants.

corrections.before: La traducción al español es una redacción de Itzli; las demás acepciones y formas no se deducen automáticamente.
corrections.after: La fuente limita esta forma a cosas y plantas. Para personas, consulta las formas documentadas de itztok.
corrections.evidence: COERLL lesson 25, section 1, body 1; person forms appear in lesson 24.
COERLL lesson 1 vocabulary item 56 identifies a teen girl, not an adolescent of unspecified gender.

corrections.before: Physical softness of clothing, food, wood, skin or leather is supported. Figurative gentleness and warmth are not inferred.
corrections.after: Describes physical softness of clothing, food, wood or leather. Figurative gentleness and warmth require separate evidence.
corrections.evidence: Modern IDIEZ yamanic senses 1–3; keep this use note within the specified everyday object senses.

corrections.before: Se documenta la suavidad física de ropa, alimentos, madera, piel o cuero. No se infieren la delicadeza figurada ni la calidez.
corrections.after: Describe la suavidad física de ropa, alimentos, madera o cuero. La delicadeza figurada y la calidez requieren evidencia propia.
corrections.evidence: Modern IDIEZ yamanic senses 1–3; keep this use note within the specified everyday object senses.

corrections.before: The modern source identifies a skirt worn around the waist. A full dress is a different garment meaning and is not verified by this entry.
corrections.after: The documented garment is a skirt. A full dress is a different garment meaning and requires separate evidence.
corrections.evidence: Modern IDIEZ cueitl field explicitly identifies skirt; restrict the public note to that garment distinction.

corrections.before: La fuente moderna identifica una falda que se lleva alrededor de la cintura. Un vestido completo es una acepción de prenda distinta y esta entrada no la verifica.
corrections.after: La prenda documentada es una falda. Un vestido completo es una acepción de prenda distinta y requiere evidencia propia.
corrections.evidence: Modern IDIEZ cueitl field explicitly identifies skirt; restrict the public note to that garment distinction.

corrections.before: A younger sibling; the entry does not restrict the sibling to one sex.
corrections.evidence: Modern Chicontepec CHOCHO, PDFpage111: younger sibling, without a gender restriction. Use the direct kinship explanation.

corrections.before: Hermano o hermana de menor edad; la entrada no limita el parentesco a un sexo.
corrections.after: Un hermano o una hermana de menor edad.
corrections.evidence: Modern Chicontepec CHOCHO, PDFpage111: younger sibling, without a gender restriction. Use the direct kinship explanation.

corrections.before: A romantic partner. The entry does not restrict the partner to one sex.
corrections.after: A romantic partner: a boyfriend or girlfriend.
corrections.evidence: Modern Chicontepec YŌLTZIN, PDFpage630: romantic partner. Give the direct learner meaning without an unnecessary demographic qualification.

corrections.before: Pareja sentimental. La entrada no limita a la pareja a un sexo.
corrections.after: Una pareja romántica: un novio o una novia.
corrections.evidence: Modern Chicontepec YŌLTZIN, PDFpage630: romantic partner. Give the direct learner meaning without an unnecessary demographic qualification.

corrections.before: Thinking privately to oneself; the thinker and the person reflected on are the same.
corrections.after: Thinking privately to oneself. The speaker addresses the thought to themself.
corrections.evidence: Modern Chicontepec ILLIA PDF256 reflexive nimo frame: the recipient is the speaker; the topic of the thought need not be the speaker.

corrections.before: Pensar en privado para sí; quien piensa y la persona a quien dirige el pensamiento son la misma.
corrections.after: Pensar para sí: quien habla se dirige el pensamiento a sí mismo.
corrections.evidence: Modern Chicontepec ILLIA PDF256 reflexive nimo frame: the recipient is the speaker; the topic of the thought need not be the speaker.
